latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker AI (v1.0.0): create, edit, and export polished MP4 videos from raw footage.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB, with 1080p output and ~1-2 minute processing via cloud GPUs.
- Automates workflow for content creators: upload footage, describe edits, and receive finished video with transitions and music.
- Efficient onboarding: automatic API connection, with free temporary tokens for new users.
- Multiple commands supported (export, credits, status, upload) and detailed error handling integrated.
- File compatibility: video (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv), image (jpg, png, gif, webp), and audio (mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
